The hard part

## Your AI agent can build the app. Getting it online is still the hard part.

AI agents are great at building apps. But putting one online still means hosting dashboards, setup steps, config, and sharing links yourself.

Dashboards

### Hosting dashboards

You leave your agent and click through a hosting dashboard to get anything online.

Setup

### Setup steps

The app still needs config and build settings before it can go live.

Sharing

### Slow sharing

Before you can share the app, you still need to deploy it, check it, and copy a live link.

The fix

## 9pm puts your agent’s app online.

9pm takes the app your agent built, deploys it for you, and returns a live URL. No hosting account, no config, no manual steps — your agent handles it and you get a link at the end.

Build

### Your agent builds the app

Works with Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any coding agent — you stay in the chat.

Deploy

### 9pm publishes it

No hosting account, no dashboard, no config. 9pm packages and publishes the app for you.

Share

### You get a live URL

When it’s done, you get a live URL you can open and share with anyone.

FAQ

## Questions before you ask for an invite.

### What is 9pm?

9pm helps you deploy apps made with Claude, Codex, Cursor, or other AI coding agents. It publishes the app and gives you a live URL.

### Which AI agents does 9pm work with?

9pm is designed for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI coding agents.

### What can I deploy with 9pm?

You can deploy prototypes, dashboards, internal tools, demos, static sites, single-page apps, and other small apps.

### Can anyone use 9pm?

Not yet. 9pm is currently invite-only while we onboard people gradually.

### Is 9pm for production hosting?

Not for now. 9pm is built for apps made by AI agents and fast live URLs, not as a general production hosting platform.

### What about security and policies?

You can read our Terms, Privacy, and Acceptable Use. We don’t claim certifications, SLAs, uptime guarantees, or enterprise-grade security.
